import json

import pytest

from conftest import FakeEntireRunner, FakeTransport, make_client
from notbydefault.entire import Entire
from notbydefault.fit.tracing import Tracer
from notbydefault.graph import Graph
from notbydefault.why import why

CHECKPOINTS = json.dumps([{"checkpoint_id": "01CPCPCPCPCPCPCPCPCPCPCPCP", "session_id": "sess-9",
                           "message": "Fit test: keep gpt-oss-120b for summaries"}])
HITS = json.dumps([{"id": "01SRSRSRSRSRSRSRSRSRSRSRSR", "type": "checkpoint",
                    "title": "chose gpt-oss-120b after the fit test"}])


@pytest.fixture
def project(tmp_path):
    with Graph.for_project(tmp_path) as g:
        d = g.add_node("decision", "openai/gpt-oss-120b", {
            "kind": "model", "category": "ai-model", "status": "reviewed",
            "verdict_summary": "Keep it: 100% pass rate at $1.51/month.",
            "decision_record": "decisions/0001-ai-model-openai-gpt-oss-120b.md",
            "affected_source": "entire-graph",
            "affected_code": [{"path": "app.py", "symbol": "summarize_notes", "line": 22,
                               "via": "uses 'openai/gpt-oss-120b' (line 27)", "depth": 0}]})
        a = g.add_node("alternative", "groq:openai/gpt-oss-20b", {"reason": "invents facts"})
        g.add_edge(d, a, "rejects")
        e = g.add_node("evidence", "Fit test results", {"path": ".notbydefault/results/1.json"})
        g.add_edge(d, e, "supported_by")
        g.add_node("decision", "MongoDB", {"kind": "service", "category": "database",
                                           "status": "unreviewed", "tool_name": "Bash",
                                           "evidence": "pymongo"}, "sess-1")
    return tmp_path


def run(project, q, search=1, transport=None, use_llm=True):
    out, t = [], Tracer()
    runner = FakeEntireRunner({("search",): search, ("checkpoint", "list"): CHECKPOINTS})
    tr = transport or FakeTransport()
    code = why(project, q, client=make_client(transport=tr), entire=Entire(exe="entire", runner=runner),
               tracer=t, out=out.append, use_llm=use_llm)
    return code, "\n".join(out), t, tr


def test_answer_cites_record_evidence_code_and_checkpoint(project):
    code, text, t, tr = run(project, "why did we pick gpt-oss-120b?")
    assert code == 0 and "The fit test kept it [F1]." in text
    for src in ("decision #1, decisions/0001-ai-model-openai-gpt-oss-120b.md", "alternative #2",
                "evidence #3, .notbydefault/results/1.json", "entire-graph: app.py:22",
                "checkpoint 01CPCPCPCPCPCPCPCPCPCPCPCP, session sess-9"):
        assert src in text, src
    assert "local checkpoints and git log (entire search unavailable" in text
    assert any(e["name"] == "search_fallback" and e["focus_area"] == "recovery" for e in t.journal)
    assert [k for _, k in tr.calls] == ["why"]


def test_entire_search_hits_are_cited_when_available(project):
    _, text, _, _ = run(project, "why gpt-oss-120b", search=HITS)
    assert "entire checkpoint 01SRSRSRSRSRSRSRSRSRSRSRSR" in text and "searched with: entire search" in text


def test_no_recorded_reason_is_said_and_no_llm_call(project):
    code, text, _, tr = run(project, "why MongoDB?")
    assert "There is no recorded reason for this decision." in text
    assert "session sess-1" in text and tr.calls == []          # nothing to phrase: no model


def test_unknown_topic_says_no_recorded_reason(project):
    code, text, _, tr = run(project, "why Kubernetes?")
    assert "There is no recorded reason" in text and tr.calls == []


def test_answer_citing_unknown_ids_is_discarded(project):
    _, text, t, _ = run(project, "why did we invent gpt-oss-120b?")
    assert "2019" not in text and "CTO" not in text
    assert "Keep it: 100% pass rate" in text                      # the plain recorded facts
    assert any(e["name"] == "citations_rejected" for e in t.journal)


def test_steps_carry_focus_areas(project):
    from notbydefault.fit.tracing import FOCUS_AREAS
    _, _, t, _ = run(project, "why gpt-oss-120b", use_llm=False)
    steps = {e["name"]: e["focus_area"] for e in t.journal if e["kind"] == "step"}
    assert steps["plan"] == "planning" and steps["graph_lookup"] == "state"
    assert steps["history_lookup"] == "context"
    assert all(e["focus_area"] in FOCUS_AREAS for e in t.journal)

"""Test scout: edge cases the agent discussed while touching a decision's code but never tested.

  1. affected code of the decision (Entire Graph analysis stored on the node)
  2. checkpoints whose sessions touched those files (`entire checkpoint list` + `explain --json`)
  3. their transcripts (`entire checkpoint explain <id> --transcript`): user/assistant text that
     mentions the files, functions or edge-case words
  4. a Groq model extracts edge cases from those excerpts, quoting its evidence; a case whose
     quote isn't in the transcripts, or that the existing test inputs already cover, is dropped
  5. the rest are saved as "suggested" verifier cases in .notbydefault/suggested/<id>.jsonl;
     nothing runs them until someone promotes them into the samples file
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

EDGE_WORDS = re.compile(r"\b(edge case|empty|blank|unicode|emoji|timezone|time zone|leap|null|"
                        r"none|missing|malformed|invalid|too long|large|huge|duplicate|"
                        r"what if|what about|fails?|crash|error|retry|timeout|rate limit|"
                        r"multilingual|language|cancel+ed|ambiguous|relative date|not tested|"
                        r"untested|corner case)\b", re.IGNORECASE)
MAX_EXCERPT_CHARS = 9000
MAX_CHECKPOINTS = 5

SCOUT_SYSTEM = ("You extract edge cases from a coding agent's conversation that were discussed but "
                "may not be tested. Answer with one JSON object only.")
SCOUT_PROMPT = """Feature under test: {feature}
Code: {code}

Existing test inputs (truncated):
{tests}

Conversation excerpts (from Entire checkpoints):
{excerpts}

List edge cases for this feature that the conversation raises. For each, quote the exact words
from the excerpts that raise it (copy them verbatim, 3 to 20 words), and say whether the existing
test inputs already cover it. Return
{{"cases": [{{"input": "<a concrete test input for the feature>", "why": "<one line>",
             "evidence": "<verbatim quote>", "already_tested": true or false}}]}}"""


def _text(message) -> str:
    content = (message or {}).get("content") if isinstance(message, dict) else message
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        return "\n".join(c.get("text", "") for c in content
                         if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("type") == "text")
    return ""


def excerpts(transcript: list[dict], needles: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """User/assistant text that mentions the code or an edge-case word."""
    out = []
    for row in transcript:
        if row.get("type") not in ("user", "assistant"):
            continue
        text = _text(row.get("message")).strip()
        if not text or text.startswith("<"):
            continue
        if any(n and n.lower() in text.lower() for n in needles) and EDGE_WORDS.search(text):
            out.append(f"[{row['type']}] " + " ".join(text.split())[:1200])
    return out


def _norm(s: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", s.lower()).split())


def existing_inputs(project: Path, decision_id: int) -> list[str]:
    from notbydefault.fit import failures as failures_mod
    from notbydefault.fit import samples as samples_mod
    samples = samples_mod.load(project, decision_id) or []
    return [s["user_message"] for s in samples] + failures_mod.inputs(project, decision_id)


def suggested_path(project: Path, decision_id: int) -> Path:
    return Path(project) / ".notbydefault" / "suggested" / f"{decision_id}.jsonl"

def scout(project: Path, decision_id: int, client=None, entire=None, tracer=None,
          out=print) -> int:
    from notbydefault.affected import describe
    from notbydefault.entire import Entire, repo_root
    from notbydefault.fit.tracing import make_tracer
    from notbydefault.graph import Graph, affected_entries, db_path, find_affected_code
    from notbydefault.llm import parse_json
    from notbydefault.pivot import used_for
    project = Path(project).resolve()
    if not db_path(project).exists():
        out(f"No Decision Graph at {db_path(project)}.")
        return 1
    entire = entire or Entire()
    tracer = tracer or make_tracer()
    with Graph.for_project(project) as g:
        d = g.get_node(decision_id)
    if not d or d["type"] != "decision":
        out(f"No decision #{decision_id}")
        return 1
    files = find_affected_code(d)
    entries = affected_entries(d)
    needles = files + [e["symbol"] for e in entries if e.get("symbol")] + [d["label"]]
    root = repo_root(project) if entire.runner is not None else None
    prefix = ""
    if root is not None and root != project:
        try:
            prefix = project.relative_to(root).as_posix() + "/"
        except ValueError:
            prefix = ""
    with tracer.root("notbydefault.scout", {"notbydefault.decision_id": decision_id}):
        with tracer.step("plan", "planning",
                         reason=f"read sessions that touched {', '.join(files) or 'nothing'} "
                                "and look for edge cases discussed but not tested"):
            pass
        with tracer.step("find_checkpoints", "context",
                         reason="checkpoints whose sessions touched the affected code"):
            listed = entire.checkpoint_list(project)
            if listed is None:
                tracer.event("checkpoints_unavailable", "recovery",
                             f"`entire checkpoint list` failed ({entire.last_error()}); "
                             "nothing to scout")
                out(f"No checkpoints available ({entire.last_error()}); nothing to scout.")
                tracer.flush()
                return 0
            touching = []
            for c in listed:
                cid = c.get("checkpoint_id")
                info = entire.checkpoint_explain(cid, project) if cid else None
                touched = {f[len(prefix):] for f in (info or {}).get("files_touched") or []
                           if f.startswith(prefix)}
                if touched & set(files):
                    touching.append((cid, c, sorted(touched & set(files))))
                if len(touching) >= MAX_CHECKPOINTS:
                    break
        texts, sources = [], []
        with tracer.step("read_transcripts", "context",
                         reason=f"{len(touching)} checkpoint(s) touched the code"):
            for cid, c, touched in touching:
                rows = entire.checkpoint_transcript(cid, project)
                if rows is None:
                    tracer.event("transcript_unavailable", "recovery",
                                 f"checkpoint {cid}: {entire.last_error()}; skipped")
                    continue
                found = excerpts(rows, needles)

"""Milestone 4 part 6: test scout over Entire checkpoint transcripts (mocked CLI and LLM)."""
import json

import pytest

from conftest import FakeEntireRunner, FakeTransport, make_client
from notbydefault.entire import Entire
from notbydefault.fit.tracing import Tracer
from notbydefault.graph import Graph
from notbydefault.scout import scout, suggested_path

LIST = json.dumps([{"checkpoint_id": "01TOUCH", "session_id": "sess-a"},
                   {"checkpoint_id": "01OTHER", "session_id": "sess-b"}])
TRANSCRIPT = "\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in [
    {"type": "user", "message": {"role": "user", "content": "In app.py, what about empty notes? "
                                                             "Blank lines might crash summarize_notes"}},
    {"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [{"type": "text", "text":
        "Good point: summarize_notes with empty notes is an edge case we haven't tested."}]}},
    {"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_use", "name": "Edit"}]}},
    {"type": "user", "message": {"content": "unrelated: rename the README"}},
])


def runner(transcript=TRANSCRIPT, listing=LIST):
    return FakeEntireRunner({
        ("checkpoint", "list"): listing,
        ("checkpoint", "explain", "01TOUCH", "--json"): json.dumps({"files_touched": ["app.py"]}),
        ("checkpoint", "explain", "01OTHER", "--json"): json.dumps({"files_touched": ["README.md"]}),
        ("checkpoint", "explain", "01TOUCH", "--transcript"): transcript,
    })


@pytest.fixture
def project(tmp_path):
    with Graph.for_project(tmp_path) as g:
        did = g.add_node("decision", "openai/gpt-oss-120b", {
            "kind": "model", "category": "ai-model", "status": "reviewed", "file": "app.py",
            "files": ["app.py"], "affected_source": "entire-graph", "affected_files": ["app.py"],
            "affected_code": [{"path": "app.py", "symbol": "summarize_notes", "line": 22,
                               "via": "uses literal", "depth": 0}]})
    return tmp_path, did


def run(project, did, transport=None, r=None):
    out, t = [], Tracer()
    r = r or runner()
    tr = transport or FakeTransport()
    code = scout(project, did, client=make_client(transport=tr),
                 entire=Entire(exe="entire", runner=r), tracer=t, out=out.append)
    return code, "\n".join(out), t, tr, r


def test_scout_keeps_quoted_untested_cases_as_suggested(project):
    p, did = project
    code, text, t, tr, r = run(p, did)
    assert code == 0 and [k for _, k in tr.calls] == ["scout"]
    # only the checkpoint that touched app.py has its transcript read
    assert ["checkpoint", "explain", "01OTHER", "--transcript"] not in r.calls
    [case] = [json.loads(l) for l in suggested_path(p, did).read_text().splitlines()]
    assert case["status"] == "suggested" and case["checkpoint"] == "01TOUCH"
    assert case["input"] == "notes with an empty line"
    assert "[suggested] notes with an empty line" in text and "[checkpoint 01TOUCH]" in text
    names = [e["name"] for e in t.journal]
    assert "drop_tested_case" in names            # the fake marks "a single note" as tested


def test_cases_with_invented_quotes_are_dropped(project):
    p, did = project
    transcript = TRANSCRIPT.replace("what about empty notes?", "what about long notes?")
    code, text, t, _, _ = run(p, did, r=runner(transcript))
    assert "0 kept" in text
    assert any(e["name"] == "drop_unquoted_case" and e["focus_area"] == "recovery" for e in t.journal)


def test_rerun_does_not_duplicate_suggestions(project):
    p, did = project
    run(p, did)
    run(p, did)
    assert len(suggested_path(p, did).read_text().splitlines()) == 1


def test_no_checkpoints_touching_the_code_means_no_llm_call(project):
    p, did = project
    listing = json.dumps([{"checkpoint_id": "01OTHER", "session_id": "sess-b"}])
    code, text, _, tr, _ = run(p, did, r=runner(listing=listing))
    assert "No discussed edge cases" in text and tr.calls == []


def test_entire_unavailable_degrades(project):
    p, did = project
    code, text, t, tr, _ = run(p, did, r=FakeEntireRunner({}))
    assert code == 0 and "No checkpoints available" in text and tr.calls == []
    assert any(e["name"] == "checkpoints_unavailable" for e in t.journal)

"""`notbydefault checkpoints <id>`: the Entire checkpoint of the commit that added a record.

  1. the decision's record path (decisions/NNNN-<slug>.md)
  2. `git log --diff-filter=A` -> the full SHA of the commit that added it
  3. its checkpoint: the commit's `Entire-Checkpoint:` trailer, else
     `entire checkpoint explain --commit <sha> --json`
  4. the matching rows of `entire checkpoint list --json`, and the link
     https://entire.io/gh/<owner>/<repo>/commit/<FULL_SHA>
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path

from notbydefault.entire import Entire, commit_link, git, repo_slug


def record_commit(project: Path, record: str) -> str | None:
    """Full SHA of the commit that added `record` (oldest add wins), or None."""
    out = git(["log", "--diff-filter=A", "--format=%H", "--", record], project)
    shas = (out or "").split()
    return shas[-1] if shas else None


def checkpoint_of(project: Path, sha: str, entire: Entire) -> str | None:
    body = git(["log", "-1", "--format=%B", sha], project) or ""
    m = re.search(r"^Entire-Checkpoint:\s*(\S+)", body, re.M)
    if m:
        return m.group(1)
    info = entire.checkpoint_explain(sha, project, commit=True)
    return (info or {}).get("checkpoint_id")


def show(project: Path, decision_id: int, entire: Entire | None = None, out=print) -> int:
    from notbydefault.graph import Graph, db_path
    from notbydefault.records import existing_path
    project = Path(project).resolve()
    if not db_path(project).exists():
        out(f"No Decision Graph at {db_path(project)}.")
        return 1
    with Graph.for_project(project) as g:
        d = g.get_node(decision_id)
    if not d or d["type"] != "decision":
        out(f"No decision #{decision_id}")
        return 1
    path = existing_path(project, d)
    if path is None:
        out(f"Decision #{decision_id} has no decision record yet; run "
            f"`python -m notbydefault records {decision_id}` and commit it.")
        return 1
    rel = path.relative_to(project).as_posix()
    entire = entire or Entire()
    slug = repo_slug(project)
    sha = record_commit(project, rel)
    out(f"Decision #{decision_id} {d['label']}: record {rel}")
    if sha is None:
        out("  not committed yet: commit it, then run this again. Its checkpoint link will be "
            f"https://entire.io/gh/{slug or '<owner>/<repo>'}/commit/<FULL_SHA>")
        return 0
    out(f"  added in commit {sha}")
    cid = checkpoint_of(project, sha, entire)
    out(f"  checkpoint: {cid or 'none linked (' + (entire.last_error() or 'no Entire-Checkpoint trailer') + ')'}")
    rows = entire.checkpoint_list(project)
    if rows is None:
        out(f"  `entire checkpoint list` unavailable: {entire.last_error()}")
    else:
        mine = [r for r in rows if cid and r.get("checkpoint_id") == cid]
        out("  entire checkpoint list:" + ("" if mine else " (no matching row)"))
        for r in mine:
            out(f"    {r.get('checkpoint_id')}  {r.get('date', '')}  {r.get('agent', '')}  "
                f"\"{r.get('message', '')}\"  sessions: {', '.join(r.get('session_ids') or [r.get('session_id') or '-'])}")
    if slug:
        out(f"  link: {commit_link(slug, sha)}")
    else:
        out("  link: (origin is not a GitHub remote; format is "

"""Milestone 4 part 7: checkpoint of the commit that added a decision record."""
import json
import subprocess

from conftest import FakeEntireRunner
from notbydefault.checkpoints import show
from notbydefault.entire import Entire
from notbydefault.graph import Graph
from notbydefault.records import write_record


def git(path, *args):
    subprocess.run(["git", "-c", "user.email=t@t", "-c", "user.name=t", *args], cwd=path,
                   check=True, capture_output=True)


def setup(tmp_path, trailer=True):
    git(tmp_path, "init", "-q")
    git(tmp_path, "remote", "add", "origin", "https://github.com/Mischa0099/notbydefault.git")
    with Graph.for_project(tmp_path) as g:
        did = g.add_node("decision", "MongoDB", {"kind": "service", "category": "database",
                                                 "status": "unreviewed"})
        write_record(tmp_path, g, did, "detected")
    git(tmp_path, "add", "decisions")
    msg = "Add decision record" + ("\n\nEntire-Checkpoint: 01CHECKPOINTID" if trailer else "")
    git(tmp_path, "commit", "-q", "-m", msg)
    sha = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=tmp_path, capture_output=True,
                         text=True).stdout.strip()
    return did, sha


LIST = json.dumps([{"checkpoint_id": "01CHECKPOINTID", "session_id": "sess-1", "agent": "Claude Code",
                    "date": "2026-10-11T01:03:29+05:30", "message": "Add decision record",
                    "session_ids": ["sess-1"]},
                   {"checkpoint_id": "01OTHER", "message": "x"}])


def test_shows_checkpoint_row_and_full_sha_link(tmp_path):
    did, sha = setup(tmp_path)
    out = []
    show(tmp_path, did, Entire(exe="entire", runner=FakeEntireRunner({("checkpoint", "list"): LIST})),
         out.append)
    text = "\n".join(out)
    assert f"added in commit {sha}" in text and "checkpoint: 01CHECKPOINTID" in text
    assert "01CHECKPOINTID  2026-10-11T01:03:29+05:30  Claude Code" in text and "01OTHER" not in text
    assert f"https://entire.io/gh/Mischa0099/notbydefault/commit/{sha}" in text
    assert len(sha) == 40


def test_falls_back_to_explain_commit_without_trailer(tmp_path):
    did, sha = setup(tmp_path, trailer=False)
    out = []
    runner = FakeEntireRunner({("checkpoint", "list"): LIST,
                               ("checkpoint", "explain", "--commit"):
                                   json.dumps({"checkpoint_id": "01CHECKPOINTID"})})
    show(tmp_path, did, Entire(exe="entire", runner=runner), out.append)
    assert "checkpoint: 01CHECKPOINTID" in "\n".join(out)
    assert ["checkpoint", "explain", "--commit", sha, "--json"] in runner.calls


def test_uncommitted_record_explains_the_link_format(tmp_path):
    git(tmp_path, "init", "-q")
    with Graph.for_project(tmp_path) as g:
        did = g.add_node("decision", "MongoDB", {"kind": "service", "status": "unreviewed"})
        write_record(tmp_path, g, did, "detected")
    out = []
    show(tmp_path, did, Entire(exe="entire", runner=FakeEntireRunner({})), out.append)
    assert "not committed yet" in "\n".join(out) and "/commit/<FULL_SHA>" in "\n".join(out)

cat >> README.md <<'MDEOF'

## Entire integration

NotByDefault reads Entire for code and history, and writes decision records that Entire
checkpoints with your commits. Every Entire call degrades gracefully: when the CLI, a plugin,
login or a mirrored repo is missing, the command falls back (and says so) instead of failing.

| command | what it does | Entire used |
|---|---|---|
| `python -m notbydefault affected [id] --project P` | every file and function using a decision's model/service, stored as `code` nodes with `affects` edges | `entire graph symbols` / `edges` (falls back to the files the agent touched) |
| `python -m notbydefault require P "<requirement>"` | two lists: **stale** (a documented fact conflicts) and **needs review** (depends on deployment, or only the model's judgement) | Graph for the affected code |
| `python -m notbydefault records [id] --project P` | writes/updates `decisions/NNNN-<slug>.md` (why, evidence, rejected alternatives, caveats, affected code, history); `check`, `require` and accepted pivots do this automatically | Brain, if `entire-brain` is installed |
| `python -m notbydefault why "<question>" --project P [--llm]` | answers only from recorded facts, each cited (decision record, evidence, checkpoint/session/commit, code location); says "no recorded reason" otherwise | `entire search`, else `entire checkpoint list` + `git log`; Graph |
| `python -m notbydefault scout <id> --project P` | edge cases the agent discussed in sessions that touched the code, saved as *suggested* cases in `.notbydefault/suggested/<id>.jsonl` | `entire checkpoint list` / `explain --transcript` |
| `python -m notbydefault checkpoints <id> --project P` | the `entire checkpoint list` row and link for the commit that added the decision's record | `entire checkpoint explain --commit` |

The PreToolUse hook adds a briefing of at most 4 lines (related past decisions, rejected
alternatives, history, reusable code, each with a source id). It reads only the graph and
`.notbydefault/entire_cache.json`, then refreshes that cache in a detached process; `check`
shows the full briefing after a live refresh.

### Checkpoint links

A decision record lands in the Entire checkpoint of the commit that adds it. Its page is

    https://entire.io/gh/Mischa0099/notbydefault/commit/<FULL_SHA>

where `<FULL_SHA>` is the full 40-character commit SHA (`git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H --
decisions/<record>.md`, or `python -m notbydefault checkpoints <id>`). For example, the commit
that added `demo-app/decisions/0001-ai-model-openai-gpt-oss-120b.md` (checkpoint
`01M4KMWR0G2BHVEMNG9MMHHP6G`):
https://entire.io/gh/Mischa0099/notbydefault/commit/35c61621951e0317126ed33c88fdd99954608157

### Entire Brain

Not in the Entire plugin index as of entire 0.11.4 (`entire plugin search brain` finds nothing).
If you have it, install it with `entire plugin install <its repository URL or a local
entire-brain executable>`, then run `python -m notbydefault records --project P`. NotByDefault
only calls a Brain subcommand that the installed plugin's own `--help` documents.
MDEOF
